During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the '''capital''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nulan VI]] fell under the control of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the [[Hook Nebula campaign]], the [[Scimitar assault wing]] used deep-[[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] precision [[Bomb/Legends|bombing]] to force its surrender during the [[Siege of Nulan VI|siege]] of the planet.
